articles.title: Bitcoin left behind in the geopolitical melee
Crypto majors stuck in tight range as altcoin rotation picks up steam
articles.snippet: Bitcoin holds between $76,000 and $78,000 while AI tokens and HYPE surge; derivatives signal calm conditions with volatility selling dominating options markets.

articles.title: Bitcoin implied volatility drops to 7 month low despite macro risks
articles.snippet: BTC's implied volatility is a picture of calm even as financial headlines warn of macro risks.

articles.title: Mark Cuban says he sold most of his Bitcoin after failed hedge narrative 'disappointed' the billionaire
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor said he sold most of his bitcoin after concluding the cryptocurrency failed to act as a hedge during recent geopolitical turmoil and dollar weakness.

articles.title: US House lawmakers launch probe into Kalshi, Polymarket insider trading
articles.snippet: Representative James Comer asked CEOs of two major prediction market companies for information on their responses to insider trading after “suspiciously timed trades” related to US military actions against Iran.
